name: victor-react-native
description: Run the Elpian VM as a cross-platform Expo engine: a mini-app management system that hosts many isolated Elpian JS programs, each rendering its own React Native (2D) widget tree with embedded Godot (3D) Scene3D worlds — no JIT, App-Store-legal, web + native.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types test/host.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/hostBridge.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/style.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/components.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/patching.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/nativeBackend.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/godotEngine.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/webGodotEngine.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/widgetRenderer.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/widgetCoverage.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/nativeWidgetRenderer.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/domWidgetRenderer.test.ts
scripts.test:wasm: node --experimental-strip-types test/miniapps.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/miniappsController.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/hostBridgeVm.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/wasm.test.ts
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../ && cargo build -p elpian-rn --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/elpian_rn.wasm react-native/web/elpian_rn.wasm
